description: Applies exact-match text edits to the agent notes, in order; an empty `oldStr` appends. Record only durable facts, decisions, rejected directions, and constraints, one short line each, never progress logs or anything derivable from the website source. A passage that no longer matches fails with `validation` and returns the current notes.

edits.description: Edits applied in order against the evolving text.

oldStr.description: Exact text to find. Must match exactly once unless `replaceAll` is `true`. Empty appends `newStr` to the end.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.

name: websiteKnowledge_agentNotes_edit
title: Edit agent notes
